title: Structural properties of purely inseparable tensor base change
statement: Let k and k' be fields with k' a finite purely inseparable extension of k [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension], and A a Noetherian local commutative k-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Put d = dim_k k' and A' = A tensor_k k', with its A-algebra structure from the left factor. Then A' has an A-basis indexed by Fin d, is free [def-weil-pbc-free-module] and finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] over A, the structure map A to A' is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and A' is Noetherian.

source.place: Proposition Tag 07E5, proof of (3) => (1); locality and finite flatness are used there without proof, expanded by the agent

proof.text: Use Algebra.TensorProduct.basis A (Module.finBasis k k') to obtain an A-basis indexed by Fin d. Module.Free.of_basis and Module.Finite.of_basis give freeness and finite generation; Module.Flat.of_free and RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff give flatness. Apply IsNoetherianRing.of_finite to A and A'. This is a direct Mathlib proof with no remaining sorry.

theorem purelyInseparable_baseChange_structural
    (k : Type u) (k' : Type v) (A : Type w)
    [Field k] [Field k'] [CommRing A] [Algebra k k'] [Algebra k A]
    [IsPurelyInseparable k k'] [Module.Finite k k']
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] :
    Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin (Module.finrank k k')) A (A ⊗[k] k')) ∧
      Module.Free A (A ⊗[k] k') ∧ Module.Finite A (A ⊗[k] k') ∧
      RingHom.Flat (algebraMap A (A ⊗[k] k')) ∧ IsNoetherianRing (A ⊗[k] k')
